hook: Many first-time buyers save for the down payment and forget the second big bill.

blocks.narration: Many first-time buyers save for the down payment and forget the second big bill. It is called closing costs.
blocks.visual: Tilt-shift miniature house with a sold sign, a second unexpected envelope sliding under the door

blocks.narration: Closing costs are the fees to finalize the loan and transfer the home, often estimated at two to five percent of the price.
blocks.visual: A miniature desk covered with tiny stamped papers and a pen

blocks.narration: On a four hundred thousand dollar home, that could be roughly eight thousand to twenty thousand dollars due at closing.
blocks.visual: Small coin stacks rise from the desk into two heights showing a range

blocks.narration: They typically include lender fees, the appraisal, title insurance, recording fees, and often prepaid property taxes and homeowners insurance too.
blocks.visual: Tiny labeled boxes slide across the desk one after another in a neat line

blocks.narration: Some of these fees are negotiable. You can shop for certain services, like title insurance, and compare lenders' origination charges.
blocks.visual: A tiny magnifying glass moves between three small storefronts on the miniature street

blocks.narration: In some deals, sellers agree to pay part of the buyer's closing costs, which is called a seller concession.
blocks.visual: A miniature hand passes a small coin stack across a table to another hand

blocks.narration: Your lender must give you a Closing Disclosure at least three business days before closing. Compare it line by line with your Loan Estimate.
blocks.visual: Two glowing documents slide side by side as a tiny calendar shows three days

blocks.narration: Budget for it early and closing day gets a lot less stressful. Follow if you are saving for your first home.
blocks.visual: Keys drop into a tiny palm as warm light floods the miniature house

captions.hook_line: Saved for the down payment? Don't forget closing costs 🧾
captions.body: Closing costs are often estimated at 2% to 5% of the price, or $8,000 to $20,000 on a $400,000 home. Your lender must give you a Closing Disclosure at least three business days before closing.
